text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... for the new Trainer 
orientation, all that's left is preparing 
the handouts. That should wrap up today's 
duties—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aah, treats for Chairwoman Akikawa's cat! 
But if I head to the Director's office 
right now...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer!? Oh dear, how 
embarrassing...!
choice_data_list:
I'll make a quick dash to the Chairwoman's 
office!

I'd be happy to help prepare those 
documents.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat?! Are you really sure that's 
alright?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your kindness~...! May I 
take you up on that offer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The kitty's put on a little weight lately, 
and the Chairwoman even mentioned her neck 
was feeling heavy, soââ

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you never overfeed them! Even if 
they beg adorably... stay strong...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, truly. It feels like only 
yesterday when I was showing you around as 
a newcomer, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're a splendid trainer now 
with Umamusume under your wing!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the juniors who follow in 
our footsteps, we're counting on you, 
please!

Even so, Ms. Tazuna truly handles an 
astonishing amount of work beyond her 
duties as the 'Secretary to the 
Chairwoman.'

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you're worried about me? 
Fufufu... I truly appreciate your concern.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't you worry! I have plenty of 
stamina, and best of all—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If I can be of even the slightest help to 
the Umamusume and Trainers, nothing would 
make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It is my job, yes, but to me, it is also 
my way of life♪

As Tazuna-san smiled, I could feel an 
immense, overflowing warmth radiating from 
her……
